digest.component_or_area: CI/CD workflow and pytest test selection
propositions: Nineteen repository-policy assertions that inspect only immutable repository text/AST are redundantly executed across all four default-suite matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13) despite being OS/Python-invariant.

The shared workflow applies an identical default marker selector to all matrix cells, causing the same invariant policy tests to run four times when they need to run only once on the primary Ubuntu 3.13 cell.
Unmarked behavioral tests (runtime, subprocess, filesystem, Git) in the seven mixed modules must retain their original cross-platform default selection to preserve macOS platform coverage.

The repo_policy marker must be applied only to the exact 19 inventoried function-level nodes, excluding runtime and subprocess cases in mixed modules, with verification via pytest collection and workflow parity tests.
